summary: Turn uncertain product ideas into testable user-problem and solution hypotheses.
intents: validate this product idea before we build it
plan user interviews for a new feature
turn customer feedback into problem statements
what is the riskiest assumption in this concept
prerequisites: the product context or initial idea
access to user evidence or a plan to collect it
verify: Problem, target user and riskiest assumption are explicit
Each hypothesis has a test and a pass/fail criterion
